description: RFC 3977 §8.3.2 says: OVER with no argument and no current article must return 420 Current article number is invalid. handle_over_live() and handle_hdr_live() both return Response::current_article_invalid() (420) which is correct. But dispatch() returns Response::overview_follows() (224) with no body for OVER(None) without a group — it never reaches lifecycle.rs. The Authenticating path falls through dispatch() and returns 224 instead of 412/420. (Partially related to zmn9.25 but distinct path through dispatch for OVER(None) without group.)
title: OVER returns 424 instead of 420 when no current article
